title: S5_network_metrics
description: Instrument x obligation two-mode network computed from S3a_provision_linked_records_78.csv by 06_scripts/build_tables/build_network.py. Not hand-authored. Excludes the actor layer (webapp-only) and the SPAR-comparison bridge (not derived in v0.2 — see package README).
unit_of_analysis: one network summary object (not row-per-record); companion tables S5_node_registry.csv (one row per instrument/obligation node) and S5_network_edges.csv (one row per instrument-obligation anchoring edge) provide the row-level detail

n_instruments.description: Distinct domestic legal instruments with at least one anchoring edge. Expected: 9.

n_obligations.description: Distinct IHR 2005 obligations with at least one anchoring edge (of 45 in S1). Expected: 43.

instrument_degree_ranked.description: One entry per instrument, ranked by obligations_anchored descending. Expected obligations_anchored: LGS 21, RLGS-SI 19, RIS 11, NOM-017 6, CPEUM 5, Ley Aduanera 3, LOAPF 1, LGPDPPSO 1, RLGS-Inv 1.

degree_norm.description: obligations_anchored / n_obligations — Borgatti & Everett (1997) two-mode-centrality normalisation, i.e. against the opposite mode's size, not total n.

communities.description: Greedy-modularity communities computed on the one-mode obligation-obligation projection (shared-instrument weighted projection), NOT the multimodal network itself. Per Knoke, Diani, Hollway & Christopoulos (2021), projections collapse the shared node and inflate triangles — read this as descriptive clustering, not a validated structural-hole/clustering statistic.

cug_test.description: Conditional-uniform-graph (CUG) permutation test (1,000 draws, seed=42): is observed instrument-degree centralisation distinguishable from a random bipartite graph with the same n_instruments/n_obligations/n_edges?

provenance_note.description: States the source table, the exclusion of the actor layer and SPAR bridge from this table, and cites Knoke, Diani, Hollway & Christopoulos, Multimodal Political Networks (Cambridge University Press, 2021, doi:10.1017/9781108985000) — the same citation the manuscript marks [REF-MPN]; the author assigns the final reference number in the manuscript.

companion_files.S5_node_registry.csv: one row per node (node_id, mode, degree, degree_norm, betweenness, community — community populated for obligation-mode nodes only)
companion_files.S5_network_edges.csv: one row per instrument-obligation anchoring edge (source, target, type, weight=formal_source_level max over collapsed rows, rows=count of S3a rows collapsed into this edge)
